<?php
function hook_compound_right35(): int { echo "R|"; return 3; }
class HookCompoundScalar35 {
    public mixed $returned = null;
    public mixed $value = 100 {
        get { echo "G|"; $backing = $this->value; return $this->returned; }
    }
    public function probe(): void {
        $this->value = 100;
        $kept = ($this->value += hook_compound_right35());
        $snapshot = (array) $this;
        echo "T", $kept, ":", $snapshot["value"], "|";
    }
}
$box = new HookCompoundScalar35;
foreach ([null, false, 0, 7] as $returned) {
    $box->returned = $returned;
    $box->value = 100;
    $kept = ($box->value += hook_compound_right35());
    $snapshot = (array) $box;
    echo "C", $kept, ":", $snapshot["value"], "|";
    $box->probe();
}

<?php
class HookCompoundReceiver35 {
    public int $label = 1;
    public bool $rebind = false;
    public mixed $returned = 7;
    public mixed $value = 100 {
        get {
            global $box, $weak;
            echo "G", $this->label, "|";
            $backing = $this->value;
            if ($this->rebind) {
                $box = new HookCompoundReceiver35;
                $box->label = 2;
                echo $weak->get() === $this ? "GL|" : "GN|";
            }
            return $this->returned;
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        $snapshot = (array) $this;
        echo "D", $this->label, ":", $snapshot["value"], "|";
    }
}
function hook_compound_rebind_right35(): int {
    global $box, $weak;
    echo "R0|";
    $box = new HookCompoundReceiver35;
    $box->label = 2;
    echo $weak->get() === null ? "RN|" : "RL|";
    return 3;
}
function hook_compound_plain_right35(): int { echo "R|"; return 3; }
$box = new HookCompoundReceiver35;
$weak = WeakReference::create($box);
$kept = ($box->value += hook_compound_rebind_right35());
$snapshot = (array) $box;
echo $kept, ":", $snapshot["value"], "|";
unset($box);
$box = new HookCompoundReceiver35;
$box->rebind = true;
$weak = WeakReference::create($box);
$kept = ($box->value += hook_compound_plain_right35());
$snapshot = (array) $box;
echo $weak->get() === null ? "GN|" : "GL|";
echo $kept, ":", $snapshot["value"], "|";
unset($box);

<?php
class HookCompoundLeaf35 {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $weak_box;
        echo "D|", $weak_box->get() === null ? "BN|" : "BL|";
    }
}
class HookCompoundObject35 {
    public int $label = 1;
    public mixed $value = 100 {
        get {
            global $box, $weak_leaf;
            echo "G|";
            $backing = $this->value;
            $leaf = new HookCompoundLeaf35;
            $weak_leaf = WeakReference::create($leaf);
            $box = new HookCompoundObject35;
            $box->label = 2;
            return $leaf;
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        $snapshot = (array) $this;
        echo "B", $this->label, ":", $snapshot["value"], "|";
    }
}
function hook_compound_error_right35(): int { echo "R|"; return 3; }
$weak_leaf = null;
$box = new HookCompoundObject35;
$weak_box = WeakReference::create($box);
try {
    $kept = ($box->value += hook_compound_error_right35());
} catch (TypeError $error) {
    echo "E:", $error->getMessage(), ":", $error->getLine(), "|";
}
echo $weak_leaf->get() === null ? "N|" : "LIVE|";
echo $weak_box->get() === null ? "BN|" : "BL|";
$snapshot = (array) $box;
echo $snapshot["value"], "|";
unset($box);
echo $weak_box->get() === null ? "BN|" : "BL|";
